description: Lumped thermodynamic tank model. Open-system first-law energy balance ODE for gas temperature during fill/discharge, real-gas virial EOS for H2, lumped wall heat transfer to ambient. Tracks P(t), T(t), mass(t), SOC.
source: Leachman et al. (2009) J. Phys. Chem. Ref. Data 38(3):721-748 (virial coeffs refit to NIST H2); Bird/Stewart/Lightfoot Transport Phenomena; Moran & Shapiro 'Fundamentals of Engineering Thermodynamics' (open-system first law); SAE J2601 / Zheng et al. (2012) Int. J. Hydrogen Energy 37(2):1048-1057 (fast-fill thermal rise)

volume.note: 125 L Type IV composite tank (shared with F1a/F1b)

wall_mass.note: composite + liner mass participating in thermal storage

cp_wall.note: effective specific heat of CFRP/HDPE composite wall, Zheng et al. (2012)

UA_ambient.note: overall gas->wall->ambient conductance (lumped, shared with F1b)

internal_area.note: approximate internal wetted area of 125 L cylinder

gamma.note: heat capacity ratio cp/cv for H2 near 298 K

cp.note: specific heat at constant pressure, near 298 K, NIST

cv.note: cp - R_H2 = 14300 - 4124 ~ 10176; ideal-gas cv for diatomic H2

T_in.note: pre-cooled inlet H2 for fast fill (SAE J2601 -40 C class)

compressibility.note: Truncated pressure-series virial: Z = 1 + B(T)*P_MPa + C(T)*P_MPa^2 (P in MPa). Coefficients REFIT to NIST/Leachman (2009) H2 data: Z(300K,70MPa)=1.40, Z(240K,70MPa)=1.55, Z(300K,10MPa)=1.065. Preserved from EC012 F1b.
